scale.1: Some, but not all, applicable acceptance criteria passed.

criteria.definition: Requested circuit behavior, specified values, and component requirements.
Required nets, pin connections, power and ground connectivity.
Requested dimensions, layers, placement, and routing constraints.
Requested native/source files are complete and open or build with recorded dependencies.

rules: Before running, map every prompt acceptance criterion to exactly one rubric criterion.
Freeze applicability per prompt, identical across methods. Do not decide applicability based on an output.
Each acceptance criterion must have a concrete pass/fail test and required evidence.
Unknown evidence makes the containing criterion score null; do not guess.
Unrequested or inapplicable criteria have applicable=false and score=null.
Total is null if any applicable criterion is unknown or no criterion applies.
Critical acceptance failures make overall_pass=false regardless of total.
A missing requested deliverable is a failure, not inapplicable.
Judge produces criterion decisions; future evaluator computes totals rather than trusting model arithmetic.
